title: Find the average number of single bonds per atom for atoms of element carbo
question: Find the average number of single bonds per atom for atoms of element carbon that belong to carcinogenic molecules with IDs between TR010 and TR050.

prediction.sql:
SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) AS avg_single_bonds_per_atom
FROM (
  SELECT a.XCL_001, COUNT(b.XCL_004) AS single_bond_count
  FROM atom AS a
  JOIN molecule AS m ON a.XCL_002 = m.XCL_010
  JOIN connected AS c ON a.XCL_001 = c.XCL_007
  JOIN bond AS b ON c.XCL_009 = b.XCL_004
  WHERE a.XCL_003 = 'c'
    AND m.XCL_011 = '+'
    AND m.XCL_010 BETWEEN 'TR010' AND 'TR050'
    AND b.XCL_006 = '-'
  GROUP BY a.XCL_001
) AS per_atom_counts
